turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Doctor: Hello, I’m your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: I’ve had fever and chills with a headache since three days after my open gallbladder surgery, and I also developed right-sided chest pain that gets worse when I take a deep breath. I’ve had a productive cough for about the last 12 hours too.
Can you describe the color and consistency of the sputum you're coughing up?
I’m coughing up thick, yellow-green sputum, and it feels fairly heavy and sticky when it comes up. It’s been increasing over the last 12 hours.
Are you experiencing any shortness of breath or difficulty breathing, even at rest?
“I do feel short of breath when I move around or take a deep breath, and the chest pain makes it harder to breathe comfortably, but I’m not struggling to breathe at rest.”
Have you noticed any swelling, tenderness, warmth, or redness in either of your legs, particularly in the calves?
I haven’t noticed any swelling, redness, or warmth in either of my legs, and my calves don’t feel tender. I only feel worse with movement because of the chest pain and the cough.
Were you intubated or placed on a mechanical ventilator during or immediately after your surgery?
“Yes—I was on a ventilator for a short period right after the open surgery, but I was taken off the machine fairly soon and haven’t been intubated since then.”
[DDX] Hospital-acquired pneumonia, Pulmonary embolism, Postoperative atelectasis with secondary infection, Subphrenic abscess, Surgical site infection
